title: Live scorecard labelled assisted groundouts (and some fly outs) 'G?' (4/04–4/05)
tier_reason: dashboard scorecard label only; no state, delivery or alert effect

contract.text: The live scorecard labels each out with the fielder who made the play (a 6-3 groundout reads G6).

mechanism.text: _extract_fielder_position read only f_fielded_ball credits; assisted groundouts carry f_assist + f_putout, so they rendered as 'G?'
some routine fly outs carry only an f_putout credit, which the credit chain also ignored

watchdog.trigger: display-only: a scorecard label; no W4 boundary applies
watchdog.recovery_assertion: every recorded out resolves a fielder position on the scorecard

evidence.what: _extract_fielder_position only checked f_fielded_ball; assisted groundouts use f_assist + f_putout, 'so groundouts showed "G?" on the dashboard'
the MLB API uses f_putout rather than f_fielded_ball for some routine fly outs; the priority chain becomes f_fielded_ball > f_assist > f_putout
